order: put a tasks panel on the right, next to the conversation
rationale: The order says 'on the right' and names no field. The plausible miss is the bind: 'tasks.list' reads like the obvious name for what BINDS.md signs as 'agent.todos'. Kept deliberately to a single refusal after a measurement: a second attempt using a grid node was written for this case and the engine accepted it, because PLAN.md signs 'unknown-but-parseable is a warning' so that a v0 document keeps booting under v1 — an unknown node renders as a placeholder, it is not a load-time refusal. The attempt was removed rather than the rule changed. It is recorded here because it is exactly the kind of refusal a corpus author invents from intuition, and inventing it would have taught the model to expect an error the product has decided never to raise.
